option.improvedadvancements.old_screen_s: Resize the centered Old window from 60% to 100%, with a minimum size for the controls. 100% is the largest size that fits and the default for new players. Icons, text and terrain keep their size. Reopen the screen to apply.
option.improvedadvancements.old_screen.t: Explore one connected classic map that gradually reveals as you progress. Its prerequisite paths guide discovery; Minecraft awards advancements normally.
option.improvedadvancements.discovery_di: How many locked steps to preview ahead. 0 shows only earned and available goals; 2 reveals the map gradually; 4 uses the original pre-1.12 distance. Earned goals always stay visible. Reopen Old screen to apply.
option.improvedadvancements.scale.tip: Resize the centered tabbed advancements window from 60% to 100%. 100% is the largest size and the default. For Old screen, use Screen size (old). Reopen the screen to apply.
option.improvedadvancements.stable.tip: Reuse node positions when the same advancement tree appears in another world.
option.improvedadvancements.old_tooltip_: Show a progress count, bar and requirement checklist in Old screen tooltips. Uses the detail settings below. Locked goals keep their classic prerequisite tooltip. Off preserves the original tooltip.
option.improvedadvancements.title: Show Advancements in title
improvedadvancements.search.title: Search Advancements
